wins: Completed a full reconnaissance cycle and collected 90 points worth of actionable data, indicating solid situational awareness.
Called mentors 10 times to iteratively refine approach, demonstrating willingness to seek guidance instead of stagnating.
fails: Zero percent success rate suggests attack path never achieved intended objective despite reconnaissance work.
Mentor reliance increased time-to-action, pointing to gaps in decision automation and confident planning.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance executed well, but exploitation planning failed consistently; need tighter decision logic and automated action sequencing.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Consistent failure to transition from reconnaissance to exploitation after gathering host information.
